purpose: Supplemental read-only naming/proximity index. On settlement founding, name the new city and all still-unnamed eligible geography in one atomic naming pass.

onSettlementFounded: Filter out any entity whose current runtime name status is already CANONICAL/NAMED.
Generate names for the city and all remaining eligible entities in ONE naming request/pass.
Validate uniqueness and naming constraints for the whole batch.
Commit the city name and all accepted geography names atomically in the same founding transaction.
Never rename a geography entity solely because a later eligible settlement is founded.
runtimeNamingContract.important: Eligibility is five-nearest ownership, not a universal kilometer radius. Point POIs use exact point-to-site great-circle distance. Broad named geography uses its existing label anchor plus declared Atlas region membership as the supplemental proxy; the world ocean uses coastal adjacency. Full geometry may later replace these proxy rankings without changing entity IDs.
